changes: Repairs the verified GitHub updater for canonical versioned Setup/SHA256 release assets and enables the official latest-release feed by default.
Makes desktop heartbeat lifetime safe across Windows sleep/resume and browser timer throttling.
Prevents out-of-order Downloads polling responses from replacing newer SAB snapshots and adds a bounded status-request timeout.
Adds browser-origin protection for mutating localhost API requests and removes raw unexpected exception text from user-facing HTTP 500 responses.
Rotates Watch Folder scanning fairly beyond 100 NZBs.
Repairs the About & Updates TMDB attribution logo path and allows the attribution text to wrap cleanly at desktop and narrow widths.
Orders Completed downloads strictly newest-to-oldest by actual completion time.
Backfills real SAB completion timestamps for existing pre-v3.5.34 Completed history and preserves SAB newest-first history rank as a legacy fallback.
Fixes legacy native Completed ordering when completed_ts exists but is zero.
Removes acceptance-only files from production packaging and routes start.bat through NewzDeck.exe.
Preserves the accepted v3.5.33 SAB transfer, Automation ownership, Smart Import, and source-complete native-helper architecture.
regression_guards: Python compile validation for server.py, sab_engine.py and automation_engine.py
Canonical GitHub release asset-selection regression guard
About & Updates TMDB asset-path and text-wrapping guard
Historical SAB completion timestamp backfill and history-rank fallback guard
No SAB transfer-data-path changes relative to accepted v3.5.33
